caption: The drawing depicts a bell tower structure in the center of the composition. The bell tower consists of two main tiers. The lower tier has a single large arched opening supporting the upper tier, which features a smaller arched opening. The upper tier is topped with an ornate, domed shape that supports a cross at the peak. The bell tower is drawn in shades of black and gray, using stippling and line work to suggest texture, such as brickwork in the middle section and smoother surfaces in other parts. Below the bell tower, there are three banner-like ribbons stretching horizontally across the lower section of the image. On these banners, handwritten text reads "1816," "san antonio de pola," and "campanario," along with the signature "j. jones". The background is plain and unshaded, leaving empty space around the central objects.
title: San Antonio de Pala - Campanario
